verdict.summary: The documentation-only change remains internally consistent and introduces no correctness, soundness, security, or test-validity defect. It accurately records the draft upstream PR's review gate and the repository policy that agents must not mark it ready, explains the author-reviewer assignment limitation and documented @-mention fallback, and keeps the unrelated upstream dependency-resolution note clearly scoped away from sparq's pinned hdt 0.7.3 and qwt 0.4.0 versions. Round 1 had no findings and this round likewise has none.
